race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
race.verdict: SHARPE RATIO made a very promising debut when second over 6f here a fortnight ago, looking strong at the finish, and can go one better up in trip. His yard saddle 6 runners, with Irishamerican and Solar Palace appealing newcomers on paper. SHARPE RATIO (USA) IRISHAMERICAN (IRE) SOLAR PALACE
